primaryChecks.text: Three of the thirty chief men went down to the rock to David, into the cave of Adullam; and the army of the Philistines were encamped in the valley of Rephaim.
primaryChecks.previousContext: They stood in the middle of the plot, defended it, and killed the Philistines; and the LORD saved them by a great victory.
primaryChecks.nextContext: David was then in the stronghold, and the garrison of the Philistines was in Bethlehem at that time.
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 本文は “the cave of Adullam” と明記する。記事は洞窟と町を関連付けるが正確な洞窟位置は未確定。
